selection: First original1024support/256query episode in original80/20 inner-training pool for each original3fold. No outervalidation queries.
mode: train with no_grad; checkpoint step0 only
fixed_priority_heuristic: All3 mean extraCE<.001nat and maximum unused mass<.01 => do not prioritize binary objective. Otherwise only confirm objectives differ; no automatic training.
interpretation: L10=L2-log(p10(class0)+p10(class1)). Extra loss can be regularization/task recognition, not necessarily harmful. Tiny step0 mass does not prove identical gradients/learning; substantial mass does not establish accuracy gain. No new accuracy or outer/holdout scoring.
